text:
Riley Park: Hey, first day here. Kandji shows 'Enrollment pending: SCEP timeout' after I plugged into the upstairs dock. No DocuSign in spam. Anyone see this before?

Samira Khan: Welcome! HR should have sent e-sign. I'll reissue. The dock ports sometimes hit a captive portal which blocks SCEP. Are you on a corporate port or guest?

Riley Park: Corporate port. Dock forces wired only, so Wi-Fi is off while docked.

IT Bot: Ticket #RD-ONB-6210 created and assigned to Samira Khan.

Samira Khan: I'll provision a 90-min temp-admin so you can install our root CA and retrigger enrollment. Also resending DocuSign now.

Riley Park: Got temp sudo and e-sign. Ran:
```
curl -fsS -o /tmp/redwood-ca.crt https://pki.redwood.corp/root.crt
sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain /tmp/redwood-ca.crt
```
It said 'certificate added'. Re-ran Kandji and now shows 'profile installed'.

Samira Khan: Nice. Unplug and reconnect to let 802.1X and machine cert take effect. If Zscaler device trust still fails, do `sudo pkill -f zscaler` and reopen.

Riley Park: pkill did it. Okta shows device trusted, Kandji healthy, FileVault On per `fdesetup status`. Thanks!

Samira Khan: Noted temp-admin used; it will auto-revoke. If you need Rosetta or virtualization perms, DM and we'll approve via policy. Welcome aboard :tada:
